data.title: 战栗的龙卷 · 甜品店的身高悲剧
data.description: 高级甜品店，她踩在椅子上才够到吧台点单，被店员问「小朋友一个人吗」后周身爆发出低气压；最后买走了最贵的蛋糕——用大人的方式回击。

data.promptProse: A tall brown-eyed bakery clerk with a chestnut-brown high bun and a white apron stands behind the glass cake counter. On the customer side, short emerald-haired Tatsumaki in a green cardigan stands on a chair to see over the glass. She frowns as she points at the cake and the clerk leans forward to take the order.
